- Introduce Styra tool for list responses:
  - Useful for things like: "Tell me which improvements we can make"
  - Styra then understands the response in a structured way, and can launch a new session to work on each one (or selected)
  - This builds on introducing some session-forking, as well as tool exposure from Styra to agents.
- Some way to jump to lines based on fuzzy sorting.
- Quick actions for adding a file/directory telling the agent to read it for context
- Some way to fork out from current context, run a new track, and summarize the outcome of that track into the initial one:
  - Essentially a manual sub-agent + compaction
- Need some way of injecting dev environments:
  - Could currently rely on driva templates
  - Until better idea...
  - Could rely more on nix?
  - I wish to avoid making driva recreate dev tooling setup
  - Should rather be a way to expose the existing dev tooling in the isolated env, that the user already has set up.
- styra should be headless:
  - Current TUI is just an UI
  - Can also make a plugin for nvim
- Markdown rendering, so tables etc show nicer
- File edits view:
  - Shows a timestamped list of files that were edited/created/removed
  - Could initially rely on parsing out file edit events from agent log
  - Preferably shares the inotify functionality from orka to get an actual list:
    - But that only covers files inside the workspace...
- Workflow:
  - Set up an initial prompt
  - Execute a task list against it
  - Each task starts with the initial context and then the task, in a new session
  - This can maybe later be tied into linka
  - Part of the Driva behaviour should be orka, and this is probably part of it
- When loading a new session, even if the initial message contains the rendered backlog, the user should still be shown the prior log entries the way they were:
  - And old entries should have some indication that they were loaded and not part of this actual session.
- When a session is loaded, it should not create a new session until any input is given by the user.
- Some indication on if agent output is finished or not, for this turn.
- Should be able to edit driva conf while running:
  - Probably requires edits to driva, or bwrap, or not possible
  - Maybe have to re-launch driva session, which will trigger a session resume.
- pgup/down in log list
- Open diff of edited file in vim
- Open diff of all edits in vim
- Side-by-side diff with delta?
- Generic run command on file in file action
- Parse bash commands and render them nicer
- G/gg bindings
- j/k, up/down should move between the entries that have extended info available, only

  - Render lines in the same way as in the main log view, but without the arrows and body contents. Only single lines.
- Clear options for driva invocation
- Some way of listing models and selecting between them on-the-fly:
  - This will affect caching, I suppose?
- Tag sessions
- Store more metadata in sessions:
  - Git repo, if any

  - Dir where launched
- Concept of a Styra session is not the same as an agent session:
  - Maybe it's a "project", or workspace?
  - It can have many associated agent sessions

- When resuming sessions with the same model provider, use the actual raw session logged from the agent.
  - Otherwise do a translation between the JSON formats
  - Or, if we can't, a text transcript
- Resuming of sessions (copy of functionality in codex/claude):
  - Maybe use original transcripts unless model in styra was changed
- For file change/read/write messages in logs, store a hash of the file just after that message:
  - That way we can say in the preview window if we're viewing the same content that was originally written or not.
- Experimental workflow:
  - Git commit after any agent response that makes an edit:
    - Maybe rely on inotify?
  - Forking a session also branches the repo
  - Allows resetting both session and branch to some previous state and continue from there
  - Easier to launch multiple agents from the same starting point, seeing what results they come up with
- Often I ask the agent to give suggestions of something.
  It then often lists multiple options.
  I then would like that to become an actual list in styra, rather than just part of the context.
  Then I should be able to pick each of those things and choose to implement them, or continue discussion, forked from the current discussion.
  This should preferably be implemented as linka nodes later.
  Getting the information out may need to be implemented as parsing of the agent response.
  Alternatively, supply instructions to the agent, or even MCP interface, to make it respond in a structured way that I can store.
